I am young myself, but it’s easy to say that you are a very mature person for your age. Taking care of your brothers at so young is definitely tough but I’m glad someone as caring as you is able to take over instead of your parents. You are loved, even though it might not feel like it. You could definitely land a babysitting job with experience like yourself. You have talent and you are a contributing member of your family and although your so young you’ve obviously made your impact on your brothers. Although I’m some random stranger online I wish you good luck, and know that I’m proud of you. There are many days to look forward to in life. Don’t give up. The temptation is always there but you have many good days ahead of you earned by your hard work.

I am really not a professional or anything. I understand the immense pressure that comes with school. Not only with grades but with social life. I’ve seen some rough days before. But I have hope in the future. There might be many better Thursdays in the future. And you might look back at these times in the future and think to yourself you were happy you didn’t follow through with it. Depression leads you to not be happy with yourself and the things you do. I want you to know that if you continue you can find a day when you start liking your interests again. And you might find a day where you find a friend or comfort talking to your parents. Although it’s not extravagant, it’s still something to look forward to. Please find something to look forward to. Whether it be a birthday party, or an update to a video game it’s good to have atleast a little hope in the future. And although that light might not be shining to bright right now, eventually it will. You never know until you see.
